Payper

Simplify expenses with ease among friends, families and colleagues.

Payper is a mobile application that allows users to easily split the cost of a bill or expenses among a group of people. This can be useful in a variety of situations, such as when dining out with friends, going on a group vacation, or making a large purchase with others.

With Payper, users can input the total cost of a bill and specify how much each person in the group should pay. The app will then calculate the amount that each person owes and allow users to pay their share directly through the app using a linked bank account or credit card. Some bill split apps also offer additional features, such as the ability to track expenses over time and send reminders to group members who have not yet paid their share.

Problem Statement

Splitting bills with friends or colleagues can be a complicated and time-consuming process. It often involves calculating and dividing expenses manually, which can lead to errors and disagreements. Additionally, keeping track of who paid for what and how much each person owes can be difficult, especially for larger groups. This results in frustration and confusion, and can sometimes damage relationships.

The need for a quick and easy way to split bills among groups is evident. Payper aims to provide a user-friendly solution that simplifies the process of splitting bills and ensures accurate calculations and record-keeping for all users involved.

Solution
  • Creating a user-friendly interface that simplifies the bill-splitting process and reduces the likelihood of errors and misunderstandings.
  • Allowing users to input the total amount of the bill and the number of people in the group as well as alllowing users to input individual expenses and who paid for them.
  • Providing a summary of the split bill, including each person's share and a breakdown of each expense.

Wireframes

The screens highlight the key features and functionalities of the app, such as a personalized menu, easy navigation, and a clear order summary. Additionally, we incorporated user feedback throughout the design process, ensuring that the app is intuitive and meets the needs of its users.

Main Features

Dashboard

This is the home screen for the users to access groups, bills and the transaction information. It displays the groups, bills created, when it was created and who is it splitted with.

Create group

To split bills, you can create your own group or join an existing one.

  • Enter a name for your group, such as "Friends' Night Out" or "Work Lunch Crew."
  • Invite your friends or colleagues to join the group by sending them the QR code.
  • Use the invitation link or group code provided by your friends or colleagues to join their existing group.

Add expenses

  • Start adding expenses to the app by entering the details of each transaction.
  • Include the total bill amount, tax, tip, and any additional charges if applicable.
  • Specify who paid for the expense and provide a brief description or note to help you remember the transaction.
